essay.title: SECTION B - THEORY
essay.instruction: Answer four (4) questions. Question One is compulsory. Show all necessary workings clearly.

questions.question:
QUESTION 1 — COMPULSORY
The table below shows a hypothetical age distribution of the population of a town in Nigeria.
Using the information provided, calculate:
(a) X, Y and Z
(b) The total population of the town
(c) The difference between the male and female population aged 14 years and below
(d) The percentage of the population aged 14 years and below
(e) The dependency ratio in the town.

(a) Differentiate between economic growth and economic development.
(b) List and explain five features of an underdeveloped economy.

Given the demand and supply functions:
Qd = 20 − 2P
Qs = 6P − 12
(a) Determine the equilibrium price and quantity.
(b) If the price is fixed at ₦6.00, calculate the magnitude of excess supply.
(c) If the price falls to ₦2.00, calculate the magnitude of excess demand.
(d) Present your answers graphically.
Discuss five instruments used by the Central Bank of Nigeria to regulate the Nigerian economy.
Explain five positive contributions and five negative effects of petroleum on the Nigerian economy.
